name: An Orphan Looking For a Home
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Oh, hello, adventurer. I'm so glad to see you again. How was your trip to Darnassus?

Well, you'll be happy to know that we've made quite a bit of progress while you've been gone. We even saved a nest full of eggs. Unfortunately, the mother died before we got to her.

Say, would you want one for a pet? They look to hatch soon, so they'll need a good father. What do you say?

If you're really interested, take one of the eggs to Quentin at the race tracks in Shimmering Flats. He'll tell you more.
narrative.objectives: Speak to Quentin in Thousand Needles.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah, a sprite darter egg, and one near maturation, if I'm not mistaken. Remarkable you've found one, let alone in this good a condition. They're rarely seen in Feralas these days. I understand there were various poachers in the area trying to capture and kill them for many reasons. Too bad really... such beautiful creatures when they reach adulthood.

How did you come across such a find?
narrative.requestItemsText:
Why hello, Champion.

Don't let my location fool you, I'm really not here for the races... as entertaining as they may be.

I'm actually here in Thousand Needles investigating all I can to find out how salvageable the land is. It has become my crusade of sorts to revitalize and replenish the area with new, fertile soil. Perhaps I'll find there's a water source nearby.

Tell me you haven't noticed how odd the transition between Feralas and Thousand Needles is. Strange magic was afoot when that happened.

chain.subtitle: 8 quests from level 47 to 48, 23,540 XP in all.

quests.name: Freedom for All Creatures
quests.objectiveText: Using the Bamboo Cage Key, free the Sprite Darters from the pen in the Grimtotem camp.

quests.name: Doling Justice
quests.objectiveText: Kill 12 Grimtotem Naturalists, 10 Grimtotem Raiders, and 6 Grimtotem Shamans before returning to Jer'kai Moonweaver in Feralas.

quests.name: Doling Justice
quests.objectiveText: Take Jer'kai's Signet Ring to High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind in Darnassus.

quests.name: An Orphan Looking For a Home
quests.objectiveText: Speak to Quentin in Thousand Needles.

quests.name: A Short Incubation
quests.objectiveText: Bring 2 Elixir of Fortitudes to Quentin in Thousand Needles.

quests.name: The Newest Member of the Family
quests.objectiveText: Take your Fragile Sprite Darter Egg to the Hinterlands and speak to Agnar Beastamer, but hurry, you only have 1 hour to find him before the hatchling within the egg dies.

quests.name: Food for Baby
quests.objectiveText: Bring 5 Silvermane Stalker Flanks to Agnar Beastamer in Hinterlands.

quests.name: Becoming a Parent
quests.objectiveText: Speak to Agnar Beastamer in the Hinterlands.
